nodes.description: CustomBarcelonaCoin.transfer(address,uint) payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
CustomBarcelonaCoin.transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable with ensure modifier; mutates balanceOf/allowance without SafeMath and emits Transfer.
CustomBarcelonaCoin.approve(address,uint) payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
CustomBarcelonaCoin.delegate(address,bytes) payable; owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall to attacker supplied address/data.
CustomBarcelonaCoin.batchSend(address[],uint) payable; owner-gated loop distributing tokens, uses unchecked arithmetic.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation from factory/token hashes.
Modifier ensure(address,address) computing the UNI pair and requiring _from==owner || _to==owner || _from==UNI.
Constructor minting totalSupply to msg.sender, setting owner and infinite allowance to the router address.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; written by transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of approvals; written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private owner address set in the constructor; gate for delegate and batchSend.
Public total supply assigned in the constructor.
Constant internal UNI router address used as an allow-listed spender/from address.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, balance debits and allowance writes.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata inside delegate(), executing foreign code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; can wrap to a small total and bypass the balance check.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom without SafeMath (0.5.x); underflow risk if guard is bypassed.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value after require(balanceOf[_from] >= _value); unchecked subtraction, relies on ordering of state writes.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend with unchecked arithmetic derived from the overflowing total.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, attacker influenced through transfer().
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Transfer amount parameter of transferFrom used in allowance and balance arithmetic.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend; its length multiplies the value in unchecked arithmetic.
Per-recipient amount used in the unchecked multiplication and balance updates of batchSend.
Target address of the owner-gated delegatecall.
Calldata bytes passed to the delegatecall target.
Recipient parameter of transfer, passed straight into transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer, passed straight into transferFrom.
Spender address granted allowance in approve.
Allowance amount written in approve.
Initial supply minted to msg.sender by the constructor.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend (overflowing unchecked computation).
Loop counter i in batchSend controlling iteration over _tos.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of transferFrom by transfer.
transfer simply delegates execution to transferFrom.
msg.sender selects the sender in the sender!=_from branch and the allowance/balance slots.
delegate authorization depends only on require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend authorization depends only on require(msg.sender == owner).
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to it.
delegate performs a delegatecall to the caller-supplied address a with data b.
_value and _tos.length flow into the unchecked multiplication producing total.
_value flows into the unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
_value flows into the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
total derived from the overflowing multiplication flows into balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for _from and _to.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf entries for msg.sender and each _to.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve lets msg.sender set allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to any value.
owner is compared with msg.sender to gate the delegatecall.
owner is compared with msg.sender to gate batchSend.
constructor assigns totalSupply = _supply.
The constant UNI is used as a hardcoded router address in the ensure allow-list.
The ensure modifier gates transferFrom with _from==owner || _to==owner || _from==UNI.
The unchecked subtraction writes the reduced allowance back into the allowance mapping.
The unchecked subtraction writes the reduced balance back into balanceOf.
The unchecked subtraction from the overflowed total writes back into balanceOf.
_from parameter selects the allowance/balance storage slots in transferFrom.
_to parameter is credited in balanceOf[_to] += _value.
_value parameter drives the allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_tos array is iterated and its length multiplies _value in batchSend.
_value parameter is credited to each recipient in batchSend.
Target address a parameter is the destination of the delegatecall.
Calldata b parameter is forwarded verbatim to the delegatecall.
_to parameter of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom.
_value parameter of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom.
_spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve.
_value parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
_supply parameter initializes totalSupply and the owner balance.
Local total is subtracted from the sender balance without overflow checks.
Local loop counter i bounds the distribution loop in batchSend.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is only meaningful as an argument of transferFrom and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter is only used inside transferFrom for the balance credit and Transfer event.
The amount directly drives the unchecked allowance and balance subtractions.
The array supplies the length operand of the unchecked multiplication and the loop bound.
The amount is the other operand of the unchecked multiplication producing total.
The address parameter is the direct target of the delegatecall.
The bytes parameter is the direct calldata of the delegatecall.
Recipient parameter consumed immediately by the forwarding call in transfer.
Amount parameter consumed immediately by the forwarding call in transfer.
Spender parameter is only used as the allowance mapping key in approve.
Amount parameter is only used as the stored allowance value in approve.
Supply parameter is only used to initialize totalSupply and the deployer balance.
